event_name: Williams Martini Racing Document 27 Date 07 July 2018 Time 15:42 2018 BRITISH GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 July 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 24) and heard the driver and team representative, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 35 did not enter the Pit Lane and continued on track during a Red Flag Signal.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 31.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence, positioning data and telemetry, and heard from the driver of car 35 (Sirgey Sirokin) and team representative. The red flag came out after the driver had passed the light panel at the entry of Turn 15 and the driver was fully committed to the turn. The following panel was at Pit Entry, and as soon as the driver could have reasonably seen the panel, he braked hard and made an attempt to safely enter the pit lane, but was unable to reasonably do so. The team reacted appropriately, and the driver drove the lap afterwards at safe speeds. Therefore the Stewards determine to take no further action. All
rules_referenced: Article 31.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
